conference.name: ARCTIC
conference.description: The northernmost, and therefore coolest, Apple developer conference.

editions.introduction: Indies connected to ARCTIC are putting together a bundle to add a little more to every attendee’s ticket. Hey Ho!
editions.accessIntroduction: Redemption details are being arranged with the conference team. There is nothing to claim here yet. Once the bundle is ready, this page will explain how ticket holders receive their offers and how to redeem each one.

valueSummary.explanation: The total counts one compatible offer per app. Xarra’s free yearly subscription and discounted lifetime purchase are alternatives, so only the larger saving is counted. RetroRapid’s contribution is assumed to include Unlimited Plays. Final offer pricing, eligibility, and redemption details are still being arranged.

editions.bundleNote: We’re working on expanding the bundle and its value.

participations.quote: I ran a workshop at the first ARCTIC edition. The quality, in every respect, took us by surprise for a first edition. Many of us came back the next year, and I’m planning to return for a third time!

offers.description: Turn articles, books, and documents into audio with synchronized highlighting. Read along, listen hands-free, or switch between the two.
offers.terms: One-time purchase. Choose this or the free year.
offers.redemptionInstructions: Not open yet. Eligibility and deadline to be confirmed; instructions will come through the conference.

offers.description: A little LCD nostalgia. Dodge traffic, chase a high score, or race a friend live with SharePlay. Released with love from ARCTIC in Oulu.
